en.headline: Fourth rat hepatitis E case linked to Kowloon City home
en.dek: An 80-year-old woman living in the same Kowloon City care home as a 91-year-old man confirmed last week tested positive and remains without symptoms, the Centre for Health Protection said.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Wednesday it is investigating a human infection of rat hepatitis E virus in an 80-year-old woman who is a family member of a 91-year-old man with underlying illnesses confirmed last week. The two cases are epidemiologically linked.

The woman lives in the same residential care home for the elderly in Kowloon City District and has a similar daily routine. The centre arranged a blood test as a precaution. The Public Health Laboratory Services Branch found the sample positive. She has had no symptoms of rat hepatitis E and is in stable condition. The centre will arrange further hospital assessment.

Neither patient travelled during the incubation period, reported direct contact with rodents, or saw rats at the home. Besides meals at the home, they ate at a restaurant in Homantin Plaza at least once or twice a week with family. The centre said that restaurant is the more likely source and did not rule out indirect contact with places or food contaminated by rats or their droppings.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department inspected the restaurant again and found cleaning still under way. The premises have suspended business on the department's instructions for thorough cleaning, disinfection and rodent-proofing. Family members, other residents and staff have no symptoms and remain under medical surveillance. The centre said this is the fourth rat hepatitis E case in Hong Kong this year.

zh.headline: 大鼠戊肝再多一宗 與九龍城院舍個案有關連
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布，與上周確診的91歲男子同住九龍城安老院的80歲女家屬驗出大鼠戊型肝炎，沒有病徵，情況穩定，屬今年第四宗。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周三表示，正調查一宗人類感染大鼠戊型肝炎個案，患者是上周公布的91歲長期病患男子的家人，兩宗個案有流行病學關連。
該名80歲女子與男病人居於九龍城區同一所安老院，日常活動範圍大致相同。中心為審慎起見為她抽血，公共衞生化驗服務處證實樣本呈陽性。女病人一直沒有大鼠戊型肝炎病徵，情況穩定，中心將安排她到醫院進一步檢查及評估。
兩人潛伏期內沒有外遊，沒有直接接觸鼠隻，亦沒有在院舍看見鼠蹟。除院舍餐飲外，他們每周至少一至兩次由家人陪同到何文田廣場一食肆用餐。中心根據目前調查認為感染源頭較大機會為該食肆，不排除兩人曾間接接觸受老鼠或其排泄物污染的地方或食物。
食物環境衞生署人員再到該食肆巡查，發現仍在清潔消毒，並已按指示暫停營業，進行徹底清潔、消毒及防鼠措施。兩名病人的家人、院友及職員暫無病徵，正接受醫學監察。中心指此為今年第四宗大鼠戊型肝炎個案。
